output.reason: Company collective labour agreement (PKB) of PT Airfast Aviation Facilities that sets payroll components entering permanent employees' gross income and deductions for PPh 21. It sets new base wage scales with 4% (1 April 2024) and 3% (1 April 2025) increases, THR of 2 months base wage, and leave allowance of 1 month base wage. It also sets shift, transport, meal-in-kind, radiation (net) and acting-supervisor allowances, a productivity bonus, and overtime rules. Finally, it sets BPJS contribution splits: employer JKK 1.74%, JKM 0.30%, JHT 3.70% and employee JHT 2%, plus BPJS Kesehatan employer 4% and employee 1%.
